Unreal Engine Level Designs

Fragments of the Forgotten

Fragments of the Forgotten: Fragments of the Forgotten is a school piece I made in Unreal Engine with pre-bought/free assets and self-modeled props. Some of the rocks and the camera were made by me, while everything else is free-use and reused in a cinematic. The cinematic was shot in Uneal Engine, and edited slightly in Adobe Premiere.

Sancuary

Sanctuary: This piece was created for a school project with pre-chosen Unreal Engine marketplace free-use assets, with the goal to make a cohesive "garden" scene. My take was to make a cyber-prayer space, that holds some of humanities last plants.

Unity Level Designs

Don't Look Down Asset Farm

All modular assets were made in Blender, and implimented into Unity 6.

Created as part of my Senior Exhibition Project for University, called Don't Look Down.
